target: Multilabel paragraph-level (practice_type, actor, polarity) triples. Repeated identical triples collapse; opposing scoped triples are retained.
coverage_contract: Unannotated rows and uncovered practice types have zero target masks.
A covered practice with no annotated propositions is explicitly absent: all actor/polarity triples for that practice are known negatives.
For a present covered practice, supervise all four polarities only for the explicitly annotated actors. Other actors remain unknown.
A scoped denial is not a known negative for the same practice in another actor's role.
Topic label masks never substitute for risk coverage. Annotation unclear is an explicit target, not missing supervision.
input: Full paragraph text only. Actor, recipient, spans, original verbs, coverage, notes, IDs and topic labels are targets/provenance, never inference features.
limits: Paragraph-level triples do not extract actors or resolve scopes in source text. Actor roles and action normalization follow the supplied annotation conventions; structural validation does not certify their semantic accuracy.
